title: One line of the airgap agent's report (build/airgap/calls.jsonl)
description: Each line of the report is one JSON object matching this schema: one risky call, refused, allowed or reported, with who made it. Words follow GLOSSARY.md.

kind.description: What kind of risky call it was. database, http and mail are recognised from higher-level calls and describe the call better than tcp alone.

target.description: What the call tried to reach: host and port, URL, JNDI name, command, library, exit status or file path.

outcome.description: refused: stopped, with the exception an unplugged machine would throw. allowed: on the allowlist, and went ahead. reported: the agent was in report mode, so the call went ahead and was only recorded.

allowed_by.description: For an allowed call, which part of the allowlist allowed it: always (the machine itself, or the package repository in the build), the project's settings file, or the test's own allowance.

proxy.description: For a call made through an HTTP proxy, the proxy, as host and port; the target is then the destination behind it, judged as well as the proxy.

test.description: The test that was running, as class.method, when the call was made on a thread the test owns. Absent for calls outside tests, or from shared thread pools.

caller.description: The first stack frame in the project's own code, as class.method(File.java:line).

stack.description: A trimmed stack trace, innermost first.

name.description: The property that held the address, for example spring.datasource.url.

from.description: Where the property's value was read, as file:line, where known.

setting.description: For Spring applications: the setting that supplied the address, where the agent can tell.

spring_start_up.description: For Spring applications: the call was made while Spring was starting the application or a context, as configuration fetched at start-up (Spring Cloud Config, Vault, a JNDI data source) is: a dependency the code itself may never name.

profiles.description: For Spring applications: the profiles active when the call was made.
